world_companies.name: World companies — the planets of Agent World
open: venture separation — Notion open question on M3 (one world per venture vs planets in one world)
rules: Zone map derived, never hardcoded: the overlay builds planets from this key and towns from ops_clients at scan time; npm test greps overlay code for company and client names and fails on a hit (V-U12)
A company with substrate null renders as an empty planet carrying its name and 'no substrate yet' — no runs, no towns, no badges, no reads; it costs nothing at rest
Every run is placed by its client: client → the company whose clients list names it, else the home company; client null → the home campus (Tellefsen HQ). No run is ever placed by actor (Annex III)
Adding a company is one entry here; its colony file is created on first render. Removing one deletes the entry; the file stays until cleaned by hand

The M3 venture-separation question (one world per venture vs planets in one world) is open in Notion and nothing here pre-empts it. This key survives either answer: status active + substrate for a co-rendered planet, status sibling + world_url for a separately deployed world the home planet links to
Renderer holds no state: this key and ops_clients are read; only the colony files are written

world_pack names the World Pack a planet wears (RA Component 10, Decision 2026-09-06 🟡 Working): a folder overlay/packs/<world_pack>/pack.json in the fork declaring skin, rooms, names and the layout file. The renderer reads the id here and loads the pack files; absent → tellefsen-campus, the default for Tellefsen SPC and its ventures. A client town wears its company's pack unless ops_clients.world_branding.pack says otherwise (that column is M3 work — the first client town). A pack names rooms, never clients. Switching this value swaps skin, rooms and names with no code change — that swap is part of V-U12
world_companies.decided: 2026-09-06 (Agent World M2 pre-flight, chat). Company names confirmed by Christoffer the same day by tap. world_pack added 2026-09-06 (chat) from the World Packs decision.
world_companies.purpose: Read by the Agent World renderer (Build Pack M2, U12 / ES-4.1–4.2): one planet per company, each wearing the World Pack named by world_pack. The home planet is the default colony file; every other planet has its own data/colony.<key>.json. Nothing in this key is a client — towns come from ops_clients (Active rows) at scan time, never from here.

_schema.entry: <skill or skill:step> → {run_mode: human_gated | unattended_allowed, since: YYYY-MM-DD, reason: one line, finding_url: the System Health finding that motivated it, review_due: YYYY-MM-DD}
_schema.precedence: an entry here overrides the skill's run_class default in run_classes; absence means the class default applies
_schema.who_writes: a human, on a Run Governance finding (RG-02 demote, RG-03 promote after evals). The sweeps never write here.
